message.content: {"label": "RISKY", "explanation": "The counter initialization for non-fwdCamera configurations starts at 0 and is only incremented on loopback confirmation, so the very first steering command sent before any loopback is received will always use idx=0 regardless of the camera's current counter, potentially causing a GM EPS counter gap fault; additionally, the counter is no longer bounded/reset (no modulo on the counter itself, only on idx), which is a behavioral change from the previous approach of deriving idx directly from the CS counter."}
